items.title: Ike Robertson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: I played with a guy across the river... That was old man Henry Allen.

ctx.x: Now they play... Was it Flea the Bird? Well, that's a march. That's a funeral march. I remember that.

Did you ever play funeral marching? Oh, yeah. Oh, yeah. I played with a guy across the river and he had a funeral you'd better know how to read when you go there. Oh, yeah. That was old man Henry Allen. Oh, yes.
You played Henry Allen's band then, too. You heard him, man. Yeah, he had nothing but real funeral march.
